messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx error rate detected from inference-runtime (model-runner). Auto-paging oncall. Error spike began ~1732109950.

maria: seeing surge of 502/504 from gateway -> model-runner pool. latency also up for long-context requests (~>2s token synthesis).

ashwin: root logs show repeated segfaults in `model_runner_worker` on node gpu-rt-03, thread dump attached. stacktrace points to quantized-kernel: `quant_kernels::attention::apply` before OOM.

pj: confirmed. core dumps present, OOM-like memory growth then SIGSEGV. repro pattern: long prefix + batched streaming requests. Not all pods affected.

maria: customer-impact: two largest customers on dedicated capacity report 30-40% request failures and timeouts. Support escalation page created.

pj: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) remove affected nodes from LB pool 2) enable fallback routing to `redwood/llm-small-1` variant with CPU fallback and smaller ctx 3) disable batch coalescing for the route to avoid huge contiguous KV caches.

maria: doing step 1 now — marking node gpu-rt-03 out/cordon in fleet.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: host gpu-rt-03 marked DRAINING by maria at 1732110005.

pj: command to flip route fallback (prod API):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"redwood/llm-small-1","disable_batching":true}'
```

pj: I'm applying the override now to take load off quant kernels.

ashwin: also bumping model-runner replicas for hot spare on non-quant nodes, and turning on verbose mem profiling.

devon: taking oncall lead for the next shift — I'll own post-mitigation monitoring and customer comms. pls handoff any active debug threads.

maria: handoff noted. pj and ashwin, can you summarize what you need from runtime team?

pj: need a hotpatch to skip the failing attention kernel for sequences longer than 2048 and force fallback kernel (less optimized but safer). minimal patch to runtime: add guard in attention dispatch. If hotpatch OK, we'll roll to affected pool only.

runtime-lead: runtime team acknowledged. starting hotpatch branch + canary build. ETA 15-20m to canary.

maria: customers updated: support message sent to SME contacts, mitigation steps in place, will follow up once stable.

pj: canary deployed on 2 pods with override. Initial observations: no segfaults so far on canary 10m post-deploy. error rate on routed fallback dropped from 35% -> 4%.

ashwin: memory trace shows the kernel guard prevented the runaway allocation on canary. good sign.

devon: i'll keep the LB routing to fallback for 30m, then slowly shift traffic back to normal with canary coverage. please ping if we see >5% errors.

incident-bot: note: escalation to oncall page completed; next steps logged to incident document at /incidents/1732109999.

maria: postmortem actions to track: full root-cause analysis of quant kernel edge case, add unit/regression tests for long-prefix batching, autoscale guard for KV cache growth, and a rollout plan for safer kernel selection.

runtime-lead: agreed. i'll own kernel fix PR and tests. devon please coordinate customer follow-ups and SLA remediation if needed.

devon: on it. thanks everyone. marking this thread for Handoff -> oncall rotation. :white_check_mark:

pj: closing live mitigation. will follow up with a changelog + PR references in runtime channel.

maria: incident status -> mitigated (errors down, hotpatch canary healthy). moving to postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident state updated to MITIGATED at 1732110450.
